title: Alder Sway
description: A quiet dance rocks in two dotted gestures against three melodic beats. A shortened bar leaves it briefly unbalanced; later two expanded bars allow its descending phrase to linger. The last dance retains these memories in a softened, compact conclusion.
technical_note: Keep the dotted accompaniment independent of the three-beat melody. Count the isolated 2/4 and 4/4 bars without abrupt changes of pulse. Shape the upper line through its syncopations and keep the bass from accenting every bar.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
